author: teteumac
body:
#### PR description:

  Remove redundant and unfilled MET offline DQM histograms in METAnalyzer.cc:

   Remove MET_HBHENoiseFilter in JetMET/MET/{pfChMet,pfMet,caloMet,pfMETT1}/{Cleaned,DiJet}:
    these eight folders already require the same HBHE decision, and the filtered histogram
    duplicates MET.

   Remove the eight filter histograms in JetMET/MET/caloMet/Uncleaned when METType="calo" and
    runcosmics=True: their decisions stay false in this mode. The filters are HBHE, HBHEIso,
    CSCTightHalo, CSCTightHalo2015, eeBadSc, EcalDeadCellTrigger, EcalDeadCellBoundary, and
    HcalStripHalo.

   In a separate commit, remove 195 commented-out lines referring to the 46 inactive BXm2BXm1
    histogram names. The active C++ token sequence is identical before and after this cleanup.

  Booking, registration, and filling use the same conditions and exact folder paths. The
  comparison verifies collision Uncleaned filters and efficiencies, PUPPI, trigger subfolders, and
  the remaining JetMET objects. This PR has no external dependency.

  #### PR validation:

  Built and tested with CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-29-2300, el9_amd64_gcc14, in the CMS EL9 container.
  Base commit: c490709683b8ec56386d5ba16b1e506d7f2f1420, verified as an ancestor of cms-sw/
  cmssw:master (cfc33e9b2e957b4e19afe00cf9c2cbf47dbf9721). Reference and candidate use identical
  expanded configurations, CPU, four threads, one stream, and the same ordered events.

| Test | Events | Run / lumi | Era | GlobalTag |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| JetMET1 collisions | 100 | 403663 / 478 | `Run3_2026` | `161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen260520_v1` (`auto:run3_data_prompt`) |
| CaloMET cosmics | 20 | 345755 / 923 | `Run3` | `150X_dataRun3_v8` (`auto:run3_data`) |

  Input LFNs:

  /store/data/Run2026D/JetMET1/RAW/v1/000/403/663/00000/014fd79f-04ba-4348-9b08-e8cf079de65c.root
  /store/data/Commissioning2021/Cosmics/RAW/v1/000/345/755/00000/1c021cc2-1f14-44cd-8f0a-
  7f5784f57ade.root

  The collision test runs RAW2DIGI,L1Reco,RECO,DQM:@jetmet, then HARVESTING:@jetmet. Cosmics
  explicitly runs RAW2DIGI,L1Reco,RECO,DQM:DQMOfflineCosmicsJetMET, then
  HARVESTING:DQMOfflineCosmics_SecondStepJetMET; the generic cosmics DQM sequence does not
  schedule this MET coverage. Both use DB:Extended geometry and DQMIO input for harvesting.

  Results:

   All eight collision HBHE/MET pairs are populated and exactly equal in the reference: 99100
    entries in Cleaned, 6162 in DiJet.

   All eight cosmic filter histograms have zero entries, content, errors, and statistics in the
    reference; the corresponding MET histogram has 20 entries.

   Each candidate removes exactly the eight intended histograms for its mode. The other 2,163
    JetMET objects in collisions (including 2,101 histograms) and 117 cosmic histograms are
    exactly equal. Comparison includes all cells and underflow/overflow, binning, entries, errors,
    statistics, labels, profile population/accumulators, and harvesting fit parameters.

   Both builds, all four event jobs, and all four harvesting jobs exit zero. No new framework
    exceptions or errors were found.

   git diff --check, git cms-checkdeps -a -A (zero additional packages), scram b code-checks, and
    scram b code-format pass. scram b runtests completes; this package has no registered unit
    tests in this checkout.

  The general runTheMatrix.py -l limited -i all --ibeos battery has not been run locally. This PR
  is submitted as a draft pending the broader CMSSW CI/RelVal checks. The reference IB's unrelated
  HLTrigger/Tools:testHltDiff failure and Phase-2 heavy-ion Step0-DAS_ERROR were identified before
  testing.
title: [DQM] MET DQM cleanup master
